rationale: C25 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are short messages to a visiting foreign president, wish that the visit around the United States will be enjoyable, invoke Mrs. Eisenhower, and express the hope that the visitor will retain pleasant memories of the country. The unusually close combination of purpose, sequence, and language materially exceeds generic diplomatic courtesy. C14 and C02 share visit-related diplomatic language but do not parallel the child nearly as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: wish you health and happiness as well as enjoyment of the visit you are making around our country
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that your sojourn in this country will be most enjoyable and that you will have the opportunity during your visit to various parts of the United States
shared_material.explanation: Both extend enjoyment wishes concerning a foreign president's ongoing visit around the United States.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: Mrs. Eisenhower and I are indeed sorry
shared_material.explanation: Both incorporate Mrs. Eisenhower's personal sentiments in the concluding portion.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the wish that you will carry from the city pleasant memories
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We sincerely hope that you both will have many pleasant memories of your visit to our country.
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive and close verbal parallel centered on retaining pleasant memories of the visit.
